rationale: Every override is a measured mesh+slot -> texture mapping derived from a capture drawcall cluster. Per-row rationale records the capture tex_id, the cluster size, and the visual / colour reason the assignment is accepted. SCHOOL multi-level slots are out of scope (see [[jn-school-multilevel]]). Curated subset of the Phase 0 review queue: high-confidence by alpha shape (transparent billboards) and by colour role (sand, sign, gold/black hazard, brown trunk). Rows whose only capture candidate is 052e7090 grass are kept only when the mesh is foliage (trees, branches, bushes, 2D billboard trees) -- not when it is a house/chimney/car (those rows are deliberately skipped pending non-grass evidence).

overrides._rationale: Phase 5 tree-billboard work surfaced a brown structure visible in front of Jimmy that no native mesh was rendering (RampsNEW02). Direct per-drawcall XZ-cluster matching (no ubiquity gate, no aggressive bucketing) found wood-brown 0408fda8 at 61u XZ -- a real, specific texture pairing the Phase 3b ubiquity gate had been too aggressive about. Re-ran the matcher against all 25 unresolved/debug_flat meshes in frustum at 8881; 9 had a single best capture drawcall within 100u XZ + a semantically-plausible texture colour. Those 9 are landed below. Medium-confidence rows (100-200u XZ) deferred to a future Phase 6 sweep.
